properties.name: llm4s.enabled
properties.description: Whether the LLM4S auto-configuration is active. Set to false to switch off the JLlmClient, LLM4STemplate and health indicator beans without excluding the starter.

properties.name: llm4s.provider
properties.description: LLM provider for the flat form: openai, anthropic or ollama. For any other provider use llm4s.providers.* instead; when llm4s.providers.provider is not set, it can also name a section of llm4s.providers. Required for the flat form.

properties.name: llm4s.model
properties.description: Model name passed to the provider, for example gpt-4o. Required.

properties.name: llm4s.api-key
properties.description: API key for the provider. Required for openai and anthropic; never logged.

properties.name: llm4s.base-url
properties.description: Override the provider's base URL. Defaults: openai https://api.openai.com/v1, anthropic https://api.anthropic.com, ollama http://localhost:11434.

properties.name: llm4s.organization
properties.description: OpenAI organization id (openai only).

properties.name: llm4s.context-window
properties.description: Total token capacity of the model (prompt plus completion). Must be positive.

properties.name: llm4s.reserve-completion
properties.description: Tokens held back from the prompt for the completion. Must be non-negative and smaller than llm4s.context-window.

properties.name: llm4s.async.max-threads
properties.description: Maximum worker threads of the default llm4sTaskExecutor bean (idle threads time out). Define your own bean named llm4sTaskExecutor to replace the executor. Must be at least 1.

properties.name: llm4s.async.queue-capacity
properties.description: Queued completeAsync calls the default executor accepts before rejecting new ones (the returned future then fails). Must be at least 1.

properties.name: llm4s.health.probe
properties.description: Make the health indicator send a one-token completion to the provider. Off by default because it is a billed call; when off the indicator reports probe=disabled and only that the client is configured.

properties.name: llm4s.health.probe-ttl
properties.description: How long a probe result is reused, so frequent health polling does not call the provider each time. Must not be negative.

properties.name: llm4s.health.probe-timeout
properties.description: A probe taking longer than this is cancelled (interrupting the provider call) and reports DOWN. Must be positive.

properties.name: llm4s.providers.provider
properties.description: Name of the default section of llm4s.providers, the provider the starter creates a client for. Mirrors llm4s.providers.provider of the HOCON configuration.

properties.name: llm4s.providers
properties.description: Provider sections, llm4s.providers.<name>.<key>, for any provider on the classpath: provider (the provider id, for example gemini, azure, mistral, openai-compatible), model, api-key, base-url, headers.<Header-Name> and the keys the provider declares (for example endpoint, api-version, and authentication = entra-id with client-id, for azure). kebab-case names are read as the camelCase names of the HOCON block. When any key is set here the flat llm4s.provider, llm4s.model ... are ignored.

properties.name: llm4s.credentials
properties.description: A vendor's shared credentials, llm4s.credentials.<provider id>.api-key, used by every section of that provider that sets no api-key of its own.

properties.name: llm4s.http.proxy.url
properties.description: HTTP proxy every provider client goes through, http://host:port (an http proxy, with its port); a user:password@ in it is the proxy's credentials. Mirrors llm4s.http.proxy.url of the HOCON configuration, which reads HTTPS_PROXY. Empty for none.

properties.name: llm4s.http.proxy.username
properties.description: User name for the proxy's Basic authentication.

properties.name: llm4s.http.proxy.password
properties.description: Password for the proxy's Basic authentication; never logged.

properties.name: llm4s.http.proxy.non-proxy-hosts
properties.description: Hosts reached directly, not through the proxy: a name (localhost), a domain suffix (*.internal), a prefix (10.*) or *. Replaces the default, the loopback addresses.

properties.name: llm4s.http.tls.trust-store
properties.description: Path of a trust store (PKCS12 or JKS) of CA certificates trusted in addition to the JDK's, such as a corporate CA behind TLS inspection.

properties.name: llm4s.http.tls.trust-store-password
properties.description: Password of the trust store; never logged.

properties.name: llm4s.http.tls.key-store
properties.description: Path of a key store (PKCS12 or JKS) holding the client certificate for a gateway that requires mutual TLS.

properties.name: llm4s.http.tls.key-store-password
properties.description: Password of the key store and its key; never logged.
